sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरः शत्रुघ्नो यमुनां नदीम् ।तीर्त्वा मधुपुरद्वारि धनुष्पाणिरतिष्ठत ।। ७.६८.३ ॥
transliteration: etasminnantare vīraḥ śatrughno yamunāṁ nadīm ।tīrtvā madhupuradvāri dhanuṣpāṇiratiṣṭhata ।। 7.68.3 ॥

translations.english: In the meantime, the brave Shatrughna, having crossed the Yamuna river, stood at the gate of Madhupura with his bow in hand.
